summary: Expose bounded operational attributes and bottleneck queries

delivery.outcome: Produce a compact deterministic bottleneck subgraph from explicit sanitized operational projections.
nonGoals: Do not crawl filesystems, networks, repositories or implicit registries.
Do not copy arbitrary scalar fields, grant authority or choose remediation.

architecture.decision: Extend the experimental discovery graph with list-record entities, a closed vocabulary of bounded operational attributes and deterministic OR filtering.
architecture.rollback: Remove list entity attributes and multi-term filtering while retaining ticket-077 string discovery.

validation.evidence: Positive and negative fixtures plus a live read-only PR-controller projection produce a compact deterministic bottleneck graph.
